visual.general_description: Grayscale frontal radiograph of the chest and upper abdomen with a white R marker at the upper left, two blue arrows and two yellow arrows.
visual.detailed_description: Frontal grayscale radiograph showing the lower rib cage, thoracic spine, a rounded soft-tissue shadow at the upper middle and a very large dark gas-containing area filling much of the abdomen. A white R marker is at the upper left corner. One blue arrow points down and to the right in the upper left of the image over the large dark area; a second blue arrow at the right edge points up and to the left toward gas-containing loops. Two yellow arrows point upward side by side near the bottom edge over a lower soft-tissue density. At the lower left there are mottled gas-containing shapes. A thin curved linear line crosses the right upper part of the image. No text other than the R marker, no scale and no patient information are visible.

visual.general_description: Color intraoperative photograph of gloved hands holding a large pink bowel loop with a yellow arrow at its lower right.
visual.detailed_description: Color photograph taken during surgery. Two hands in white gloves hold a large glossy pink-red loop of bowel with branching surface vessels over an area of tan skin, surrounded by green surgical drapes. The loop is gathered and folded toward the lower center, where a small crumpled tissue-like area is visible next to a yellow arrow pointing left. A pink and white cloth lies at the right and a third gloved hand enters at the lower right. No face, text or patient labels are visible.

visual.general_description: Color photograph of a large curved pink-orange bowel segment lying on a green surgical drape among surgical instruments.
visual.detailed_description: Color photograph of a large curved, crescent-shaped bowel segment with a glossy surface, prominent branching vessels and orange-brown staining, lying on a green drape. Metal surgical instruments such as clamps and forceps lie at the lower left and bottom, one pair of clamps is positioned at the central opening of the curve, stainless-steel bowls are at the right and a white gauze piece is at the upper right. In the background are a pale wall and a gray metal panel with a small handle and printed non-Latin characters that are too small to read. No face or patient label is visible.
